title: I'm Not Trying To Forget You Anymore
original_lyrics:
[verse]
I'm not trying to forget you anymore
I got back into remembering all the love we had before
I' been trying to forget someone who my heart still adores
So I'm not trying to forget you anymore
You just someone who brought happiness into my life
and it did not last forever but that's all right
we were always more than lovers and I'm still your friend
if I had the chance I can do it all again
So I'm not trying to forget you anymore
I got back into remembering all the love we had before
And the best days of my life are still when you walk through my door
so I'm not trying to forget you anymore

[verse]
I'm not trying to forget you anymore
I got back into remembering all the love we had before
And I' been trying to forget someone who my heart still adores
So I'm not trying to forget you anymore
I'm not trying to forget you anymore
